description:
The Dark Heresy Alpha is already available to anyone that has the Developer's Digital Pack or Collector's Edition. Get your copy now and get Alpha access using the link https://darkheresy.owlcat.games/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=owlcat&utm_content=influencer&utm_term=playontabletop


In a special episode of 40k in 40m Mubin and Nick play a Boarding Action game inspired by Owlcat Games upcoming Dark Heresy. Nick's entire Inquisitorial retinue consists of characters custom made from the Crucible of Champions character creating rules as is Mubin's Warlord.  Will the retinue discover the dark secrets of the Undercity or will the disciples of the Dark Gods keep their secrets hidden in the shadows?
